evidence_text: Environment Agency LIDAR Composite First Return DSM 1m metadata: raster elevation model covering approximately 99% of England at 1 m spatial resolution; first-return surface model includes buildings, vegetation, vehicles and terrain where the first/only return is ground; EPSG:27700; vertical accuracy +/-0.15 m RMSE; annual updates; creation 2023-02-08; revision 2023-12-15; period 2016-11-11 through 2022-05-05; Open Government Licence; no public access constraints. Spatial binding, raster sampling/materialization and height-difference calculation remain local-only.
